description.value: The New Denver Visitor Centre is a tourism information office situated in the small historic village of New Denver on the western shore of Slocan Lake in the West Kootenay region. New Denver anchors a scenic cycling corridor through the Slocan Valley and is home to the nationally significant Nikkei Internment Memorial Centre, making it a culturally rich stop on any touring itinerary. The village also offers access to local trails, Centennial Park, and the Kohan Reflection Garden.
